tips.text: Rank one Lato, one Bolto, the Akbolto and the Dual Skana to 30 before the next step eats them; the second Lato and Bolto need no ranking.
Keep five weapon slots free; people hit the limit partway through the Lato and Bolto steps.
Start both Boltos first, since they are the longest wait, and buy the Dual Skana and Akbolto blueprints while they cook.
Treat Akjagara as Mastery fodder; players say it is mediocre for the credits.
